en.summary: The former Catalan president is considering the timing and method of his return to Catalonia to avoid accusations of opportunism.

stories.title: Messi se despide de la selección argentina ovacionado por una multitud: “Es el día más triste de mi carrera”

en.title: Messi bids farewell to Argentine national team applauded by a multitude: "It is the saddest day of my career"
en.summary: Argentina defeated Benin 3-0 at the Monumental stadium as Messi played his final match for the national team, scoring once and providing two assists.

stories.title: 'Ad10s' a una era: Messi se despide de la selección argentina con un gol y dos asistencias ante Benín

en.title: 'Ad10s' to an era: Messi bids farewell to Argentine national team with a goal and two assists against Benin
en.summary: The Argentine star retired from the national team after 208 matches, 126 goals, and 70 assists in a packed Monumental Stadium filled with tributes.

stories.title: Messi se despide de la selección en Buenos Aires entre fuegos artificiales y lágrimas con el himno

en.title: Messi bids farewell to national team in Buenos Aires amid fireworks and tears with the anthem
en.summary: Argentina held an emotional farewell celebration for Messi with fireworks and a special national anthem as 85,000 fans filled the Monumental Stadium for his final international match.

stories.title: Muere a los 102 años la actriz Eva Marie Saint, ganadora de un Oscar por 'La ley del silencio'

en.title: Eva Marie Saint, Oscar-winning actress from 'On the Waterfront,' dies at 102
en.summary: American actress Eva Marie Saint died on October 7 at age 102 from natural causes, surrounded by family. She won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her 1954 role in 'On the Waterfront' directed by Elia Kazan.

en.summary: An inmate remains restrained on a gurney in intensive care under police custody after surviving an execution attempt.

stories.title: Christa Pike recupera la conciencia y el habla tras sobrevivir a su ejecución con dos dosis letales

en.title: Christa Pike regains consciousness and speech after surviving execution with two lethal injections
en.summary: The first person to undergo this execution method in Tennessee in 200 years regained consciousness. Her lawyers report she remains chained to the bed despite injuries to her arms.

stories.title: Christa Pike recupera la conciencia y habla seis días después de sobrevivir a su ejecución en Tennessee

en.title: Christa Pike regains consciousness and speaks six days after surviving execution in Tennessee
en.summary: Christa Pike regained consciousness six days after surviving an execution procedure in Tennessee. Her lawyers say her recovery is unprecedented, though her prognosis remains uncertain.
